title: ADR-101: Device telemetry in TimescaleDB
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-05-12 · Owners: Data platform

Context

Every charger reports power, temperature and state every 10 seconds. We need retention policies and SQL joins against the device registry.

Decision

Device telemetry is stored in TimescaleDB on our existing Postgres cluster. We will not introduce InfluxDB as a separate time-series store.

Alternatives considered

  • InfluxDB: rejected. Another database to operate, and Flux queries cannot join the registry.
  • Amazon Timestream: rejected because of query cost at our ingest rate.

title: 2026-06-03 Connectivity sync — meeting notes
storage:
Attendees: Firmware, Cloud

Discussion

  • Broker outages last quarter were all on our self-hosted brokers.

Decisions

  • Decision: device-to-cloud messaging uses MQTT through AWS IoT Core; we will not run our own Mosquitto or EMQX brokers.

Action items

  • Migrate the remaining gateway line to IoT Core (Cloud team).

title: Firmware release handbook
storage:
Purpose

How firmware reaches devices in the field.

Policy

Firmware OTA updates must roll out in stages (1%, 10%, 100% of the fleet) with at least 24 hours between stages. A firmware build is never pushed to the whole fleet at once.

Exceptions

Security hotfixes may skip the 24-hour wait with CTO approval, but still start at the 1% stage.

title: Privacy rules for product analytics
storage:
Background

Chargers know where customers live.

Rule

Device location (GPS coordinates) and the owner's home address must never be sent to third-party analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics.

Aggregated, city-level counts are allowed.

title: ADR-102: Companion app built with Flutter
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-02-14

Decision

The customer companion app is built with Flutter. React Native was rejected because our BLE pairing plugin is already written in Dart.

Consequences

The internal factory provisioning tool may use whatever fits.

title: ADR-095: Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
storage:
Status: Superseded by ADR-108 · Date: 2025-09-10

Decision

Push notifications are sent through Firebase Cloud Messaging directly from the backend services.

title: ADR-108: Push notifications via OneSignal
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-07-01 · Supersedes ADR-095

Decision

Push notifications to the companion app are sent through OneSignal. We will not call Firebase Cloud Messaging directly from backend services.

Rationale: one place for segments, quiet hours and delivery stats, because three services had their own FCM code.

title: 2026-09-18 Registry scaling — meeting notes
storage:
Status: Proposed

Discussion

  • Registry lookups spike during firmware rollouts.

Decisions

  • Decision: move the device registry from Postgres to DynamoDB (proposed, not yet agreed; revisit after load test).

title: Device identity security standard
storage:
Scope

All production devices that connect to the cloud.

Standard

Every device client certificate must be rotated at least every 90 days; long-lived certificates are not allowed.

Devices on the lab bench network are exempt.

title: 2026-05-27 Firmware guild — meeting notes
storage:
Attendees: Firmware guild

Decisions

  • Decision: new firmware modules are written in Rust; no new C code in the firmware repo, except vendored chip-vendor SDK drivers.

title: ADR-104: Fleet backend services in Go
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2026-03-19

Decision

Fleet backend services are written in Go. We decided not to use Node.js for new backend services because long-lived MQTT connections leaked memory in our Node prototype.

title: 펌웨어 설정값 관리 원칙
storage:
배경

임계값을 바꿀 때마다 펌웨어를 다시 배포해야 했다.

결정

배터리 임계값, 리포트 주기 같은 펌웨어 설정값은 펌웨어에 하드코딩하지 않고 원격 설정(Remote Config) 서비스로 관리한다.
